senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="M01520">same</cite> <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 2:13">Targ. Lev. II, 13</cite>.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 31:19">Targ. Y. Gen. XXXI, 19</cite>.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 75b:2">Sabb. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>האי מאן דמ׳ בשרא וכ׳</he> he who salts raw meat (on the Sabbath) &c.
<cite ref="Chullin 113a:13">Ḥull. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ ליה גרמא גרמא</he> salted each piece separately.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 74b:8">B. Bath. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>לִימְלְחָהּ לנקבה</he> let him preserve in salt the female (Behemoth); a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="M01552"><he>מְלִיחַ</he></cite>, <cite ref="M01553"><he>מְלִיחָא</he></cite>, pl. <he>מְלִיחֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 74b:8">Ib.</cite> <he>כוורא מ׳ מעלי</he> fish in salt is good; <he>בשרא מ׳ וכ׳</he> meat in salt is not.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 74b:8">Ib.</cite> <he>ציפרי מ׳</he> fowls in salt; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="M01553"><he>מְלִיחָא</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to be strewn with salt, be salted.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 16:4">Targ. Ez. XVI, 4</cite>.—
<cite ref="Chullin 97b:4">Ib. 97ᵇ</cite> <he>אִימְּלִיחוּ וכ׳</he> were (ritually) salted … with the nervus ischiadicus left therein; a. fr.
